#import data
```{r, warning=FALSE}

#survival at each plot
surv_hi_orig <- read_excel(here("data/surv_data_hi.xlsx"), sheet = 3, skip = 1, .name_repair = "minimal")

#circle plot -- size of each alive tree in plot
circle_plot <- read_excel(here("data/surv_data_hi.xlsx"), sheet = 1, skip = 1, .name_repair = "minimal")

#pyranometer values
pyran_orig <- read_excel(here("data/surv_data_hi.xlsx"), sheet = 2, .name_repair = "minimal") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0)

#quad plot -- quadrat of soil type, vegetation type, + invasive species cover
quad_plot <- read_excel(here("data/surv_data_hi.xlsx"), sheet = 4, skip = 1, .name_repair = "minimal") %>% 
  clean_names()

consol_li <- read.csv(here("data/li_percent_surv_consolidated.csv"))

alive_vs_dead <- read.csv(here('data/dead_vs_alive.csv'), row.names = NULL)

pyran_uv <- read.csv(here('data/pyrano_uv.csv'))

wetland_info <- read.csv(here("data/status_wetland.csv"))

precipitation <- read.csv(here("data/njdep_rainfall.csv"))

air_temp <- read.csv(here("data/air_temp.csv"))

std_error <- function(x) {
  sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
}

crown_area <- circle_plot %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(year = ymd(date)) %>%                                                  #coerce date column to date form
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%                                                 #create column with date as year only
  select(plot_id, year, species = species_unique_id, height = height_m,        #select and rename columns
         dbh = dbh_average_cm, crown_diam_m = average_crown_width_m) %>% 
  mutate(crown_diam_m = as.numeric(crown_diam_m)) %>%                         #coerce to numeric
  mutate(crown_area = (pi*((crown_diam_m/2)^2))) %>%                           #get crown area from diameter
  group_by(plot_id, year) %>%                                                   #group by plot and year
  summarise(total_crown_area = sum(crown_area, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%               #add crown areas (no NAs)
  mutate(plot_id = recode(plot_id, PK_SURV1 = "1", PK_SURV2 = "2",              #rename plot ids
                          PK_SURV3 = "3", PK_SURV4 = "4", PK_SURV5 = "5", 
                          PK_SURV6 = "6", PK_SURV7 = "7", PK_SURV8 = "8", 
                          PK_SURV9 = "9", PK_SURV10 = "10", PK_SURV11 = "11", 
                          PK_SURV12 = "12", PK_SURV13 = "13", 
                          PK_SURV14 = "14", PK_SURV15 = "15")) %>% 
  mutate(plot_id = as.numeric(plot_id))                                         #coerce plot ids to numeric

```

```{r}
# Put all your data frames into a list and then combine rows
df_list <- list(usgs_a, usgs_b, usgs_c, usgs_d, usgs_e, usgs_f, usgs_g, usgs_1, usgs_2, usgs_3, usgs_4, usgs_5, usgs_6, usgs_7, usgs_8, usgs_9)

usgs_result <- bind_rows(df_list)



#separate date and time
usgs_result$date <- format(as.POSIXct(usgs_result$time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "%Y-%m-%d")

usgs_result$time <- format(as.POSIXct(usgs_result$time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "%H:%M:%S")

usgs_result <- usgs_result %>% mutate(year = year(date))

#take mean for each day
mean_day_flow <- usgs_result %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(value))

#daily discharge- convert cubic ft/s into cubic feet/day
mean_day_flow$daily_discharge <- mean_day_flow$mean * 86400

#convert to cubic m/day
mean_day_flow$daily_discharge <- mean_day_flow$daily_discharge * 0.0283168

mean_day_flow <- mean_day_flow %>% mutate(year = year(date))

#calculate mean for year
mean_year_discharge <- mean_day_flow %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(daily_discharge),
            st_err = sd(daily_discharge/sqrt(length(daily_discharge))))

#remove 1981 as it is not a full year, changes yearly average
mean_year_discharge <- mean_year_discharge[mean_year_discharge$year != 1981, ]


#subset to 2001-2025 to match rainfall data
mean_year_discharge_sub <- mean_year_discharge %>% filter(year >= 2001 & year <= 2025)

#calculate percentile rate for discharge in each year
discharge_percentiles <- mean_year_discharge_sub %>%
  mutate(
    # Method 1: Traditional relative ranking (0 to 1 scale)
    percentile_rank = percent_rank(mean) * 100)

```

#precipitation
```{r}
#separate date and time

precipitation$date <- format(as.POSIXct(precipitation$Date, format = "%m/%d/%y"), "%m-%d-%Y")

precipitation$year <- format(as.POSIXct(precipitation$Date, format = "%m/%d/%y"), "%Y")

precipitation$time <- format(as.POSIXct(precipitation$Hour, format = "%H:%M"), "%H:%M")

daily_precip <- precipitation %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(sum = sum(Value))

daily_precip$year <- format(as.POSIXct(daily_precip$date, format = "%m-%d-%Y"), "%Y")

year_mean_precip <- daily_precip %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(sum = sum(sum))

#calculate percentile rate for discharge in each year
rainfall_percentiles <- year_mean_precip %>%
  mutate(
    # Method 1: Traditional relative ranking (0 to 1 scale)
    percentile_rank = percent_rank(sum) * 100)


```

#air temperature
```{r}
air_temp$DATE <- format(as.POSIXct(air_temp$DATE, format = "%m/%d/%y"), "%m-%d-%Y")

air_temp$year <- format(as.POSIXct(air_temp$DATE, format = "%m-%d-%Y"), "%Y")

air_temp <- na.omit(air_temp)

#change from C to F
air_temp$TMAX <- ((air_temp$TMAX-32)*(5/9))

air_temp$TMIN <- ((air_temp$TMIN-32)*(5/9))

air_temp_mean <- air_temp %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(max_mean = mean(TMAX),
            min_mean = mean(TMIN),
            st_err_max = sd(TMAX/sqrt(length(TMAX))),
            st_err_min = sd(TMIN/sqrt(length(TMIN))))

```

#GLM: assess factors influencing the variability among survival of planted trees in high intensity plots
```{r}
alive_vs_dead$status <- factor(alive_vs_dead$status, levels = c("alive", "dead"))

model <- glmer(
  status ~ wetland_factor + density_tree_m_sq + distance_from_river + (1 | plot_ID) + (1 | species_ID),
  data = alive_vs_dead,
  family = binomial
)
model


model_wet_den <- glmer(
  status ~ wetland_factor + density_tree_m_sq + (1 | plot_ID) + (1 | species_ID),
  data = alive_vs_dead,
  family = binomial
)
model_wet_den

model_wet <- glmer(
  status ~ wetland_factor + (1 | plot_ID) + (1 | species_ID),
  data = alive_vs_dead,
  family = binomial
)
model_wet

model_den <- glmer(
  status ~ density_tree_m_sq + (1 | plot_ID) + (1 | species_ID),
  data = alive_vs_dead,
  family = binomial
)
model_den



model_loc <- glmer(
  status ~ distance_from_river + (1 | plot_ID) + (1 | species_ID),
  data = alive_vs_dead,
  family = binomial
)
model_loc



model_loc_den <- glmer(
  status ~ distance_from_river + density_tree_m_sq + (1 | plot_ID) + (1 | species_ID),
  data = alive_vs_dead,
  family = binomial
)
model_loc_den

model_loc_wet <- glmer(
  status ~ wetland_factor + distance_from_river + (1 | plot_ID) + (1 | species_ID),
  data = alive_vs_dead,
  family = binomial
)
model_loc_wet


model_surv_null <- glmer(
  status ~ 1  + (1 | plot_ID) + (1 | species_ID),
  data = alive_vs_dead,
  family = binomial
)
model_surv_null


model_set_surv <- list(
  full = model,
  wet_den = model_wet_den,
  wet = model_wet,
  den = model_den,
  loc = model_loc,
  loc_den = model_loc_den,
  loc_wet = model_loc_wet,
  null = model_surv_null
)

aic_table_surv <- model.sel(model_set_surv, rank = "AICc")
aic_table_surv

```

#LLM: assess factors associated with the variability of incoming solar radiation in the high intensity plots
```{r}

py_glm <- pyran_uv
py_glm$pyran <- py_glm$Pyranometer.Start.Center
py_glm <- py_glm %>%
  rename(year = Year) %>%
  mutate(plot_id = sub("PK_SURV_", "",
        as.character(Plot.ID)),
        plot_id = factor(plot_id))%>%
  select(year, plot_id, pyran, UVEIF)

crown_area1 <- crown_area
crown_area1$plot_id <- factor(crown_area1$plot_id)
pyran_crown <- left_join(py_glm, crown_area1, by = c("year", "plot_id"))


pyran_crown <- pyran_crown %>%
  mutate(
    year_sc   = scale(year, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE),
    canopy_sc = scale(total_crown_area, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))

model_can_lm <- lmer(log(pyran + 0.01) ~year_sc + canopy_sc + UVEIF + (1|plot_id),
     data = pyran_crown,
     REML = FALSE)
model_can_lm

model_canopy_year <- lmer(log(pyran + 0.01) ~year_sc + canopy_sc + (1|plot_id),
                     data = pyran_crown,
                     REML = FALSE)
model_canopy_year

model_year <- lmer(log(pyran + 0.01) ~year_sc + (1|plot_id),
                          data = pyran_crown,
                          REML = FALSE)
model_year

model_canopy <- lmer(log(pyran + 0.01) ~canopy_sc + (1|plot_id),
                   data = pyran_crown,
                   REML = FALSE)
model_canopy

model_UVEIF <- lmer(log(pyran + 0.01) ~UVEIF + (1|plot_id),
                   data = pyran_crown,
                   REML = FALSE)
model_UVEIF

model_UVEIF_canopy <- lmer(log(pyran + 0.01) ~ canopy_sc + UVEIF + (1|plot_id),
                    data = pyran_crown,
                    REML = FALSE)
model_UVEIF_canopy

model_UVEIF_year <- lmer(log(pyran + 0.01) ~ year_sc + UVEIF + (1|plot_id),
                           data = pyran_crown,
                           REML = FALSE)
model_UVEIF_year

m_null_pyran <- lmer(log(pyran+ 0.01) ~1 + (1|plot_id),
                     data = pyran_crown,
                     REML = FALSE)
m_null_pyran


model_set_pyran <- list(
  full = model_can_lm,
  canopy_year = model_canopy_year,
  year = model_year,
  canopy = model_canopy,
  UV = model_UVEIF,
  UV_canopy = model_UVEIF_canopy,
  UV_year = model_UVEIF_year,
  null = m_null_pyran
)

aic_table_pyran <- model.sel(model_set_pyran, rank = "AICc")
aic_table_pyran

```

#Figure 3: species specific survival in high intensity plots
```{r}
trees_summary <- alive_vs_dead %>%
  count(species_ID, status)

trees_summary <- trees_summary %>%
  mutate(
    species_ID = case_when(
    species_ID == "AC" ~ "Amelanchier canadensis",
    species_ID == "AN" ~ "Acer negundo",
    species_ID == "ALNSE" ~ "Alnus serrulata",
    species_ID == "AR" ~ "Acer rubrum",
    species_ID == "AS" ~ "Acer saccharinum",
    species_ID == "BN" ~ "Betula nigra",
    species_ID == "BP" ~ "Betula populifolia",
    species_ID == "CC" ~ "Carpinus caroliniana",
    species_ID == "CEPOC" ~ "Cephalanthus occidentalis",
    species_ID == "CLEAL" ~ "Clethra alnifolia",
    species_ID == "CORAM" ~ "Cornus amomum",
    species_ID == "CS" ~ "Cornus sericea",
    species_ID == "IV" ~ "Ilex verticillata",
    species_ID == "LB" ~ "Lindera benzoin",
    species_ID == "LS" ~ "Liquidambar styraciflua",
    species_ID == "NS" ~ "Nyssa sylvatica",
    species_ID == "PO" ~ "Platanus occidentalis",
    species_ID == "PP" ~ "Photinia pyrifolia",
    species_ID == "QB" ~ "Quercus bicolor",
    species_ID == "QP" ~ "Quercus palustris",
    species_ID == "QUEPH" ~ "Quercus phellos",
    species_ID == "RP" ~ "Rosa palustris",
    species_ID == "SC" ~ "Sambucus Canadensis",
    species_ID == "SD" ~ "Salix discolor",
    species_ID == "SN" ~ "Salix nigra",
    species_ID == "VD" ~ "Viburnum dentatum",
    species_ID == "VL" ~ "Viburnum lentago",
    species_ID == "W. sp." ~ "Willow",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  )

trees_summary <- subset(trees_summary, species_ID != "Willow")


totals <- trees_summary %>%
  group_by(species_ID) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

labels <- left_join(totals, wetland_info, by = "species_ID")

ggplot(trees_summary, aes(x = species_ID, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    data = labels,
    aes(
      x = species_ID,
      y = total_n,
      label = wetland_factor
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "alive" = "forestgreen",
      "dead"  = "orange"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tree species",
    y = "Number of trees",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic", angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(labels$total_n) * 1.1)

ggsave(here::here("output/Figure3_species_specific_survival.png"), width = 7, height = 5)

```

#Figure 4: solar radiation at center of high intensity plots 
```{r}
pyran_uv1 <- pyran_uv %>%
  rename(start_center = Pyranometer.Start.Center,                               #rename column names
         start_shade = Pyranometer.Start.Shade,
         end_shade = Pyranometer.End.Shade) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 6:8,                                                      #pivot to long form
               names_to = "irradiance_type",                                    #name of column with start/shade
               values_to = "irradiance") %>%                                    #name of column with pyran values
  mutate(Year = as.character(Year))                                             #coerce year column to character

pyran_summary <- pyran_uv1 %>%
  group_by(Year, Plot.Number) %>%
  summarise(
    irradiance = irradiance,
    UVEIF = mean(UVEIF, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

#Figure 6: Bray-Curtis dissimilarity and NMDS plot
```{r}
dat <- species_cover_1 %>%
  mutate(sample_id = paste(plot_id, year, sep = "_"))

comm_mat <- xtabs(
  avg_per_cover ~ sample_id + species,
  data = dat
)

comm_mat <- as.matrix(comm_mat)


comm_mat <- matrix(
  as.numeric(comm_mat),
  nrow = nrow(comm_mat),
  dimnames = dimnames(comm_mat)
)


meta <- dat %>%
  distinct(sample_id, plot_id, year) %>%
  arrange(sample_id) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id")

all(rownames(comm_mat) == rownames(meta))
# TRUE



nmds <- metaMDS(comm_mat, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100, autotransform = FALSE)
nmds$stress
#0.105

adonis_res <- adonis2(
  comm_mat ~ year,
  data = meta,
  method = "bray",
  permutations = 999,
  strata = meta$plot_id
)

adonis_res

plot_df <- cbind(
  as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites")),
  meta
)


disp <- betadisper(
  vegdist(comm_mat, method = "bray"),
  meta$year
)

anova(disp)
permutest(disp)
#not significant means PERMANOVA reflects centroid shifts

# NMDS plot ---------------------------------------------------------------

tiff(
  filename = "NMDS_Invasive_Species.tiff",
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  res = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)

plot(
  nmds,
  type = "n"
)

# Plot points
points(
  plot_df$NMDS1,
  plot_df$NMDS2,
  pch = 21,
  bg = year_cols[as.character(plot_df$year)],
  cex = 1.3
)

# Year legend
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = yrs,
  pt.bg = year_cols[as.character(yrs)],
  pch = 21,
  title = "Year"
)

# Fit species vectors
fit <- envfit(
  nmds,
  comm_mat,
  permutations = 999
)

# Create table of vector importance
vec_tbl <- data.frame(
  species = rownames(fit$vectors$arrows),
  r2 = fit$vectors$r,
  pval = fit$vectors$pvals
) %>%
  arrange(desc(r2))

# Extract vector coordinates
vec <- scores(fit, display = "vectors")

# Top 5 species with highest r²
top_species <- vec_tbl %>%
  slice(1:5)

species_cols <- c(
  "#4CBB17",
  "#FFB6C1",
  "#E69F00",
  "#800080",
  "#89CFF0"
)

yrs <- sort(unique(plot_df$year))
year_cols <- setNames(
  gray.colors(
    n = length(yrs),
    start = 0.10, # grey10
    end = 0.80 # grey80
  ),
  yrs
)
year_cols


names(species_cols) <- top_species$speci

# Arrow scaling
arrow_mult <- 1
label_mult <- 1.25

# Arrows
arrows(
  0, 0,
  vec[top_species$species, 1] * arrow_mult,
  vec[top_species$species, 2] * arrow_mult,
  length = 0.1,
  lwd = 2,
  col = species_cols[top_species$species]
)

italic_species <- c("Phalaris arundinacea",   "Lythrum salicaria", "Rosa multiflora", "Microstegium vimineum")

font_vec <- ifelse(
  top_species$species %in% italic_species,
  3, # italic
  1 # plain
)

# Species legend
legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = top_species$species,
  col = species_cols[top_species$species],
  lwd = 2,
  title = "Species Vectors",
  bty = "n",
  text.font = font_vec
)

ordiellipse(
  nmds,
  groups = plot_df$year,
  show.groups = 2026,
  kind = "sd",
  draw = "lines",
  col = "grey10",
  lwd = 3,
  lty = 2
)

dev.off()
```

#Figure 7: invasive species ground cover
```{r}
#Invasive species ground cover over time

#Import quad plot data with new formatting
quad_plot_species <- read_excel(here("data/surv_data_hi.xlsx"),
  sheet = "QUAD_PLOT",
  col_names = FALSE,
  skip = 2, .name_repair = "minimal"
)


#Create data frame to calculate ground cover over time for each species

#Important note: When the data was collected, species ground cover was put into one out of four % cover bins (0-25%, 25-50%, 50-75%, 75-100%). To make it easier to work with the data and create the following figures, the values were assumed to be the top value of each of the bins, resulting in four options of % cover (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%). 

#Another note: Each site contains measurements of four quadrats for each year (one in each cardinal direction). To calculate yearly species ground cover at each site, the four quadrats were averaged together for each species. 

names(quad_plot_species) <- c(
  "date", "plot_id", "quadrat", "soil_type", "slope",
  "veg_25", "veg_50", "veg_75", "veg_100",
  "inv_25", "inv_50", "inv_75", "inv_100"
)


quad_plot_species <- quad_plot_species %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date)
  )


species_cover <- quad_plot_species %>%
  select(
    date, plot_id, quadrat, soil_type, slope,
    inv_25, inv_50, inv_75, inv_100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("inv_"),
    names_to = "cover_class",
    values_to = "species"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species), species != "") %>%
  separate_rows(species, sep = "\\s*,\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    species = trimws(species),
    percent_cover = case_when(
      cover_class == "inv_25"  ~ 25,
      cover_class == "inv_50" ~ 50,
      cover_class == "inv_75" ~ 75,
      cover_class == "inv_100"  ~ 100
    )
  )


species_cover <- species_cover %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%                                                 #new column with date as year only
  mutate(year = as.factor(year)) %>%                                            #coerce date to factor
  select(plot_id, year, quadrat, percent_cover, species) %>%                   #select columns
  mutate(percent_cover = as.numeric(percent_cover)) %>%                         #coerce % cover to numeric
  group_by(plot_id, year, species) %>%                                         #group by plot, year, veg type
  summarise(avg_per_cover = mean(percent_cover),
            st_err = std_error(percent_cover)) %>%
  #get avg % cover
  
  mutate(plot_id = recode(plot_id, PK_SURV1 = "H1", PK_SURV2 = "H2",              #rename plot ids
    PK_SURV3 = "H3", PK_SURV4 = "H4", PK_SURV5 = "H5", 
    PK_SURV6 = "H6", PK_SURV7 = "H7", PK_SURV8 = "H8", 
    PK_SURV9 = "H9", PK_SURV10 = "H10", PK_SURV11 = "H11", 
    PK_SURV12 = "H12", PK_SURV13 = "H13", 
    PK_SURV14 = "H14", PK_SURV15 = "H15")) %>%
  mutate(species = recode(species, AP = "Garlic mustard", AV = "Mugwort", CA = "Canada thistle", CH = "Hairy bitercress", "C. sp." = "Dodder sp.", "C.Sp." = "Dodder sp.", "C. Sp" = "Dodder sp.", DF = "Common teasel", DL = "Cutleaf teasel", FV = "Lesser celandine", GA = "Bedstraw", HM = "Dame's rocket", LN = "Creeping jenny", LS = "Purple loosestrife", MV = "Japanese stiltgrass", PA = "Reed Canary Grass", "F. sp." = "Knotweed sp.", PP = "Mile-A-Minute", RP = "Black locust", RR = "Creeping buttercup", SD = "Night shade", SV = "Crownvetch", RM = "Multiflora rose"))

#create figure with invasives more categorized

species_cover_1 <- species_cover %>% 
  mutate(species = recode(species, 
                "Garlic mustard" = "Forb other", 
                "Mugwort" = "Forb other", 
                "Canada thistle" = "Forb other", 
                "Hairy bitercress" = "Forb other", 
                "Dodder sp." = "Forb other", 
                "Common teasel" = "Forb other", 
                "Cutleaf teasel" = "Forb other", 
                "Lesser celandine" = "Forb other", 
                "Bedstraw" = "Graminoid other", 
                "Dame's rocket" = "Hesperis matronalis", 
                "Creeping jenny" = "Forb other", 
                "Purple loosestrife" = "Lythrum salicaria", 
                "Japanese stiltgrass" = "Microstegium vimineum", 
                "Reed Canary Grass" = "Phalaris arundinacea", 
                "Knotweed sp." = "Forb other", 
                "Mile-A-Minute" = "Persicaria perfoliate", 
                "Black locust" = "Woody other", 
                "creeping buttercup" = "Forb other", 
                "Night shade" = "Forb other", 
                "Crownvetch" = "Forb other", 
                "Multiflora rose" = "Rosa multiflora",
                "C. Sp." = "Forb other"))

species_cover_1 <- species_cover_1 %>% 
  mutate(plot_id = factor(plot_id, levels = c("H1", "H2", "H3", "H4", "H5", "H6", "H7", "H8", "H9", "H10", "H11", "H12", "H13", "H14", "H15")))

species_cover_1 <- species_cover_1 %>% 
  mutate(species = factor(species, levels = c("Forb other", "Graminoid other", "Woody other", "Phalaris arundinacea", "Microstegium vimineum", "Lythrum salicaria", "Persicaria perfoliate", "Rosa multiflora", "Hesperis matronalis")))

ggplot(data = species_cover_1,
       aes(x = year, y = avg_per_cover,

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_per_cover - st_err, ymax = avg_per_cover + st_err),
```
